description: Checks the user's live website now. Use it when they ask what's wrong with their website, whether it's down, slow or broken, what security problems show from the outside, why their emails go to spam, or whether a change broke something. Runs a new Preventionlabs report on one of the account's verified websites and returns it as Markdown: what's broken on the live site and where (pages, browser errors, uptime, DNS, HTTPS, redirects, leaked files, email setup, and Cloudflare errors, deploys and recent changes when Cloudflare is connected), with evidence and what to do. Read-only. Takes 15 seconds to about a minute. Use it after a deploy or a DNS, hosting or email change, when the site seems down or broken, and again after a fix to prove it worked. Each run uses one of the site's daily runs (usually 2 per 24 hours); to reread the last result, use latest_report instead.

site.description: The website, e.g. example.com. Leave empty when the account has only one verified site.

name: run_report
title: Check a live website
